observed.pricing_architecture: Lovable uses a workspace-level shared credit pool rather than a per-seat model; credits fund building, cloud hosting, and in-app AI features. The public Free plan includes daily build credits plus cloud and AI-feature allowances. The captured source did not expose a full paid tier table.

plans.name: Free
plans.price_note: Includes 5 daily build credits (up to 30/month), 20 Cloud credits, and 4 AI-feature credits in captured source.

plans.name: Paid workspace plans
plans.price_note: Official pricing page presents shared-credit plans; capture did not record a complete paid price table.

free_access.note: Free plan has published build, cloud, and AI-feature allowances.

expansion_vectors.description: One pool funds product building, hosting, and AI features across a workspace.

analysis.monetization_summary: Lovable makes collaboration frictionless by pooling metered AI and cloud capacity at the workspace level.
